methods.life: all CecilSpawn lives through CecilDeath or last observed log tick; failed and right-censored included
methods.acquisition: first CecilPickup/State owned & mask; seconds_to_outcome is client tick delta times .05, not guaranteed native elapsed; native inventory ages separately reported; no ammunition readiness inferred
methods.native_inventory: independent original-server read-only samples, torn readings discarded; non-atomic; first observed positive lifetime and earliest observed inventory age; may lag actual event
methods.native_selected_ammo: first observed selected useful ranged current weapon and native has_ammo flag; not proof of fired damage or first-tick readiness
methods.frags: last query minus first query; shorter window than full runtime
methods.received_hp: sparse same-entity and same-spawn-clock HP decreases clipped at0, not armor or attacker attribution
methods.flight: begin/end exact edge/deadline; no event means not exercised, not PASS
methods.connector: nonzero ray hit beyond segment endpoint and actual clear decision; no inference of resulting pickup

flight_events.limitation: No per-tick NAV output log during two-tick finish; same-edge arrived proves planner continuation. Own pickup, not competitor removal; visible at begin, not a later visibility switch.
